quarterly_data.quarter: Organo results presentation: Financial Results for Fiscal Year Ended March 31, 2026 (05-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Fiscal year ended March 2026: several large-scale electronics orders were received in Taiwan and the United States, though some large orders were delayed beyond expectations; sales grew mainly in the electronics industry on construction progress of large projects, and operating profit benefited from improved margins on large overseas projects.

quarterly_data.quarter: Organo results presentation: Financial Results for Fiscal Year Ended March 31, 2026 (05-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Plan for the fiscal year ending March 2027: the company expects investment in cutting-edge semiconductors to remain highly active in Taiwan and the United States and orders to increase; Water Treatment Engineering electronics orders planned to rise to 157,000 from 99,065 and electronics sales to 129,000 from 108,052 (millions of yen).
quarterly_data.figure: Orders received 230.0 billion yen (+36.9%); net sales 200.0 billion yen (+12.6%); operating profit 40.0 billion yen (+6.2%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Organo results presentation: Financial Results for Fiscal Year Ended March 31, 2026 (05-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Role in semiconductor manufacturing: Organo provides ultrapure water supply facilities for cleaning wafers and chips, treatment facilities for wastewater from cleaning and other processes, water recycling systems, and systems to recover fluorine and rare metals from wastewater; it also supplies proprietary ultrapure ion exchange resins for electronic materials for cutting-edge semiconductors and is applying its EDI systems in cutting-edge semiconductor fields.
